name: Home waterproofing
summary: How tenants and owners fix waterproofing failures in Singapore — bathroom seepage, monsoon window leaks, slab diagnosis, and MCST vs unit responsibility.
body:
Tropical rain and upstairs renovations drive seepage into bathrooms, bedrooms, and window frames. Quick paint-overs fail if membranes and falls are wrong. Proper waterproofing needs diagnosis, dry-down time, and warranty paperwork.

## Typical jobs
- Bathroom floor / wall membrane renewals
- Ceiling seepage investigation from upstairs units
- Window and sliding-door perimeter sealing
- Balcony / planter waterproofing
- Moisture-meter reports for disputes

Photos and MCST letters matter before major works.

## How to choose
Prefer contractors who flood-test and issue written warranties. Ask about re-tiling scope and dry-down days. Separate diagnosis fees from full remediation quotes.

## Practical tip
Log leak times against rain and upstairs shower use for a week. Patterns shorten the blame loop between neighbours and MCST.
whenToEngage: Bathroom or ceiling seepage needs diagnosis
Monsoon window leaks after DIY sealant fails
MCST vs unit waterproofing responsibility unclear
Need moisture report for landlord / neighbour dispute
